nav.title: Circle reveal
nav.description: Click a tile: a circle wipes out from your click and covers the stage with its detail.

nav.title: New In
nav.description: Click Menu: the pill bar grows in place into a full nav panel.

nav.title: Grid item hover effect
nav.description: Hover a card: the image zooms and four clipped corners fade in with its info.

nav.title: Masses
nav.description: Click a tile: it scales up to become the detail image beside its text.

nav.title: Layer reveal
nav.description: Click Reveal: staggered bars wipe up the stage, opening onto a mosaic.

nav.title: Menu hover effects
nav.description: Six CSS-only underline animations for a nav — hover any word.

nav.title: Make way
nav.description: Hover a tile: it grows, and every other tile leans away to make room.

nav.title: Scroll-based letter bend
nav.description: Each heading reads its own scroll speed every frame and bows its middle letters away from it.

nav.title: Far from Venice
nav.description: Click the arrows: an iris wipe swaps the slide in place.

nav.title: The Algorithm
nav.description: Scroll a bounded stage: each panel pins, then dims and shrinks as the next one covers it.

nav.title: Type shuffle
nav.description: Three buttons, three ways the same phrase can scramble into place.

nav.title: Warp cursor
nav.description: Move the mouse inside the box: a trailing ring follows it and warps on the highlighted words.
